scope: Retained final and preceding review command logs, JUnit, source inventories, raw compact outputs, focused measurements, publication/reproduction helpers, and dependency-query attempts. Each embedded report retains its own source and outcome; historical attempts are not additional final-source passes.
normalization: The image-specific /opt tool directory is represented as $RUNTIME_TOOLS. Original and published byte hashes are separate; embedded hashes continue to identify original bytes. No source identity, test outcome, or measurement is relabeled.
exclusions: Disposable verification clones and baseline source exports already recoverable from Git
Generated package builds and rendered documentation
Live databases, local service ownership/connection metadata, and demonstration state
